semantics.target_aiming: origin placed relative to each target's own near face, so the declared target is first along the segment; never a shared world origin
semantics.reachability: preflight classifies REACHABLE / OCCLUDED / AMBIGUOUS / INVALID_GEOMETRY before any verdict; only REACHABLE probes carry causal evidence
semantics.identity: returned collider must BE the declared target or a preregistered physical owner; same-class neighbours are rejected
semantics.sampling: support and blocker strata quota-ed independently, 8 each
semantics.invariance: identical values across deliberately different targets raise REVIEW_REQUIRED_UNEXPECTED_INVARIANCE and force NON_PROBATIVE
semantics.reporting: generic_hit_rate and correct_target_hit_rate reported separately, never merged

proven_properties.intervention_sensitivity: disabling the declared target changes the verdict from PASS_CORRECT_CAUSE to FAIL_NO_HIT with all else fixed
proven_properties.probe_incapability_distinguished: occluded targets are NON_PROBATIVE, not failures

claim_boundary: Validates target-specific causal probing under Isaac Sim 5.1.0.0. Does NOT establish absolute world-range measurement from a shared origin, nor anything about scene quality.
